related.title: 昌吉—古泉 ±1100 kV 特高壓直流
related.transfer: 可遷移「可用率與輸電量」與「直流故障電流的上升率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；昌吉—古泉 ±1100 kV 特高壓直流的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Availability and energy transferred" and "Rate of rise of DC fault current" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Changji–Guquan ±1100 kV UHVDC Link must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界第一個直流電網：四端環網、年輸送電量、子模組電容的儲能、故障電流的上升率與直流斷路器；昌吉—古泉 ±1100 kV 特高壓直流則以三千公里、一千一百千伏的直流輸電：額定電流、以輸電代替輸煤、與八百千伏的比較、閘流體閥與雙極閉鎖為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first DC grid in the world: a four-terminal ring, yearly energy, energy in submodule capacitors, fault current rise and DC breakers; Changji–Guquan ±1100 kV UHVDC Link centres on three thousand kilometres at eleven hundred kilovolts DC: rated current, wire in place of coal trains, comparison with eight hundred kilovolts, thyristor valves and bipole block, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年輸送電量占北京用電的比例」與「額定電流」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「子模組電容的儲能」的模型移到昌吉—古泉 ±1100 kV 特高壓直流，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「可用率與輸電量」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Yearly energy as a share of Beijing demand" and "Rated current".
Move the model of "Energy stored in submodule capacitors" to Changji–Guquan ±1100 kV UHVDC Link, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Availability and energy transferred", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「可用率與輸電量」與「直流故障電流的上升率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；昌吉—古泉 ±1100 kV 特高壓直流的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Availability and energy transferred" and "Rate of rise of DC fault current" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Changji–Guquan ±1100 kV UHVDC Link must be respecified.

related.title: 維京聯網直流互聯
related.transfer: 可遷移「可用率與輸電量」與「直流故障電流的上升率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；維京聯網直流互聯的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Availability and energy transferred" and "Rate of rise of DC fault current" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Viking Link HVDC Interconnector must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界第一個直流電網：四端環網、年輸送電量、子模組電容的儲能、故障電流的上升率與直流斷路器；維京聯網直流互聯則以連接英國與丹麥的最長聯網線：兩地風電的互補、啟用初期的容量限制、陸纜的接頭與溫升、磁場與埋設為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first DC grid in the world: a four-terminal ring, yearly energy, energy in submodule capacitors, fault current rise and DC breakers; Viking Link HVDC Interconnector centres on the longest interconnector, joining Britain and Denmark: complementary wind, early capacity limit, land cable joints and heating, magnetic field and burial, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年輸送電量占北京用電的比例」與「兩地風電的互補」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「子模組電容的儲能」的模型移到維京聯網直流互聯，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直流線路損失」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Yearly energy as a share of Beijing demand" and "How two wind fleets complement each other".
Move the model of "Energy stored in submodule capacitors" to Viking Link HVDC Interconnector, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "DC line loss", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「可用率與輸電量」與「直流故障電流的上升率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；維京聯網直流互聯的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Availability and energy transferred" and "Rate of rise of DC fault current" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Viking Link HVDC Interconnector must be respecified.

history.title: 張北柔性直流電網
history.text: 2018 年工程開工建設；2020 年四端直流電網投入運轉；2022 年為冬季奧運場館供應綠電。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2018: Construction of the project began. 2020: The four-terminal DC grid began operating. 2022: It supplied green power to Winter Olympic venues. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
